title: Talent Acquisition Advisor
description:
Bring more to life.

  

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

Our 60,000\+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.  



  

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

 **Advisor Talent Acquisition**

  

We are looking for a Advisor Talent Acquisition with a proven track record of hiring senior leaders, critical positions, and niche technology talent. The ideal candidate will be a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, capable of influencing talent decisions, navigating complex searches, building strong talent pipelines, and developing recruitment capability within a global environment

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own end\-to\-end recruitment delivery for strategic, critical, niche, and highly specialized technology roles, ensuring high\-quality hiring outcomes and timely execution.
* Partner closely with senior business leaders and hiring teams to understand talent requirements, develop hiring strategies, provide market intelligence, and support informed talent decisions.
* Execute complex and high\-impact searches utilizing direct sourcing, market mapping, talent intelligence, referrals, and proactive candidate engagement.
* Serve as a trusted Talent Advisor to hiring leaders by providing consultative guidance, managing stakeholder expectations, and navigating complex or sensitive hiring scenarios.
* Build and maintain robust external talent pipelines aligned to current and future business needs, with a focus on niche technology skills including mid to senior level talent.
* Take personal accountability for hiring outcomes across assigned portfolios, proactively identifying risks, removing bottlenecks, and driving requisitions to successful closure.
* Leverage recruitment analytics, market insights, and modern sourcing technologies to strengthen talent pipelines, improve hiring effectiveness, and enhance candidate experience.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance recruiting processes, elevate hiring quality, and share expertise across the Talent Acquisition function.

### **Key Requirements**

* 10\+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with a proven track record of hiring senior leaders, critical business roles, and niche technology talent within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Ability to independently lead high\-priority and hard\-to\-fill searches, balancing multiple stakeholder groups while delivering results in fast\-paced and evolving business environments.
* Expertise in talent mapping, market intelligence, direct sourcing, referrals, and innovative recruitment strategies to identify and attract top\-tier talent across competitive markets.
* Strong ability to build credibility and influence senior executives, business leaders, HRBPs, and HR stakeholders through strategic talent guidance and data\-driven recommendations.
* Deep understanding of technology talent landscapes, including Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science, Cloud Computing, DevOps, Cybersecurity, and emerging technology domains.
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement, consulting, and strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and cultivate external leadership talent, leverage recruitment technologies and analytics, and drive informed hiring decisions through platforms such as Workday, LinkedIn, AI\-enabled sourcing tools, and market intelligence solutions.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


### **Job Description**


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with organizational goals and workforce plans.
* Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment coordination, reference checks, offer negotiation, and onboarding support.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and advanced sourcing tools to identify and engage top talent.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines to support current and future hiring needs.
* Implement sourcing strategies focused on attracting diverse and high\-quality talent while optimizing time\-to\-fill and cost\-per\-hire metrics.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through proactive communication and effective stakeholder management.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and leverage workforce analytics to improve hiring outcomes and process efficiencies.
* Promote employer branding initiatives and represent the organization positively in the talent marketplace.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, employment legislation, and recruitment best practices.


**Skill Descriptors**


### **Relationship Management**


**Knowledge of relationship management techniques and the ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with business leaders, candidates, vendors, and peers.**


* Influences hiring managers and business leaders through data\-driven recommendations.
* Builds and maintains long\-term partnerships with key stakeholders and external vendors.

### **Customer/Market Focus**


**Understanding of evolving market trends and the ability to respond to customer and business needs in a manner that consistently adds value.**


* Identifies expressed and unexpressed business talent needs.
* Aligns recruiting strategies to critical business objectives.

### **Recruitment Channel Management**


**Knowledge of selecting, implementing, and managing recruitment channels to support talent acquisition objectives.**


* Utilizes multiple recruitment channels to attract top talent.
* Identifies and manages cost\-effective sourcing partners and recruitment vendors.

### **Candidate Screening**


**Knowledge of effective candidate assessment and screening methodologies.**


* Screens candidates for professional, technical, and leadership roles.
* Ensures compliance with HR policies and recruitment standards throughout the screening process.

### **Candidate Sourcing**


**Knowledge of sourcing techniques, methods, and tools to attract top talent.**


* Develops and executes multi\-channel sourcing strategies.
* Advises business leaders on talent availability and sourcing approaches.
* Benchmarks sourcing strategies against industry best practices.

### **Staffing and Recruiting**


**Knowledge of staffing strategies, recruiting processes, and talent acquisition best practices.**


* Manages complex recruitment assignments across multiple business functions.
* Consults with stakeholders on workforce planning, recruitment strategies, and talent availability.

### **Workforce Analytics**


**Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce trends, and reporting methodologies that support informed business decisions.**


* Analyzes recruitment and workforce data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Generates reports and dashboards to support leadership decision\-making.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **At minimal 4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, or Human Resources.**
* Proven experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment for technical, professional hiring.
* Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
* Experience using ATS, CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume recruitment environment preferred.


This position requires working onsite five days a week.



Relocation is available for this position.


**Posting Dates:**



September 16, 2026 \- September 17, 2026



Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You treat ambiguity as an invitation to bring clarity, not as a reason to slow down. Stepping into complex, high\-stakes moments with a steady presence comes naturally to you. You listen carefully for what's unsaid, ask the questions that unlock momentum, and align people around the real problem, not just the loudest symptom. Tight timelines and high expectations energize you because you know how to prioritize what matters, communicate tradeoffs early, and keep progress visible without creating noise.


Partnership over posturing defines how you approach customers and internal teams. The back\-and\-forth of discovery energizes you, and you naturally translate between technical, business, and everything in between so decisions get made with confidence. You don't just deliver answers. You build trust by being transparent, direct, and constructive, especially when the message is hard. When something breaks, curiosity and methodical thinking guide you as you trace causes with patience while keeping the bigger picture in view.


Constantly looking for leverage is part of who you are. Patterns reveal themselves to you, one\-off fixes become repeatable playbooks, and you leave behind cleaner processes than you found. Precision balanced with pragmatism helps you know when to go deep and when to move forward with a well\-framed assumption. Above all, you bring a collaborative intensity that is calm, driven, and generous, helping the team move faster together while keeping quality and integrity non\-negotiable.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Support Synopsys PrimeTime Static Timing Analysis tool across pre\-sale evaluations, post\-sale deployments, and ongoing customer engagements
* Drive product adoption by running competitive benchmarks, leading customer evaluations, and articulating technical advantages to design teams and engineering management
* Deliver customer training sessions, technical presentations, and hands\-on workshops that maximize user proficiency and satisfaction with PrimeTime
* Provide tape\-out support by troubleshooting complex timing issues, resolving signal integrity problems, and ensuring successful project completion under deadline pressure
* Collaborate with R\&D, product marketing, and sales teams to relay customer feedback, influence product enhancements, and shape roadmap priorities
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, best practices guides, and knowledge base resources that scale your expertise across the customer base
* Participate in advanced customer collaboration initiatives that drive innovation, uncover new use cases, and strengthen long\-term partnerships

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerate customer project timelines by enabling efficient use of PrimeTime and optimizing design flows that remove timing closure bottlenecks
* Enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty through expert support, proactive problem\-solving, and training that builds internal capability
* Strengthen Synopsys' leadership in static timing analysis and semiconductor design solutions by delivering measurable wins in competitive engagements
* Facilitate feedback loops between customers and internal teams that drive continuous innovation in product features, usability, and performance
* Empower customers to achieve superior chip performance, power efficiency, and cost optimization that directly affect their product success
* Contribute to successful tape\-outs and high\-impact design wins for industry\-leading clients building next\-generation silicon
* Build reusable methodologies and documentation that multiply your impact across the global customer base and internal teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Deep hands\-on expertise in Synopsys PrimeTime STA tool, including advanced features, timing analysis methodologies, and real\-world application across multiple design nodes
* Strong understanding of timing corners, process variations, signal integrity issues, and how they affect timing closure in modern semiconductor designs
* Familiarity with synthesis, physical design, extraction, and ECO methodologies, and how they integrate with static timing analysis workflows
* Proficiency in TCL scripting for automation, tool customization, and workflow optimization
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience in customer\-facing roles, experience delivering technical training or presentations is a plus
* BSEE or equivalent with 3\+ years of relevant experience, or MSEE or equivalent with 4 years of experience in applications engineering, design, or verification roles

### **Who You Are**

* You collaborate naturally, valuing diverse perspectives and fostering environments where different technical viewpoints strengthen the outcome
* Proactive problem\-solving defines your approach. You work independently, manage multiple priorities without losing threads, and know when to escalate or pull in help
* Adaptable and resilient, you thrive when priorities shift, timelines compress, or technical challenges require creative thinking under pressure
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to delivering high\-quality results, you catch the edge cases and corner conditions that others miss
* You can explain a complex timing closure tradeoff to a customer VP in two sentences without losing the nuance, and then turn around and debug a TCL script with an engineer
* You notice when a customer question signals a deeper workflow issue, and you address both the immediate ask and the underlying gap

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You'll join a talented applications engineering team that supports the industry\-leading Static Timing Analysis tool, PrimeTime. The team's core purpose is to drive increased product usage, ensure customer success, and collaborate closely with R\&D, marketing, and sales to foster innovation. Together, you will enable customers to build next\-generation silicon chips faster and more efficiently, playing a vital role in Synopsys' global leadership in chip design and verification.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: JBPIND - US Recruiter Salaried
description:
Company Overview
  
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is a subsidiary of J.B. Poindexter \& Co., Inc. a privately held diversified manufacturing company forecasting $2\.5B in annual revenue and 8,500 team members in 2026\. The eight operating subsidiaries, covering over 50 locations, are engaged in the production of commercial truck bodies, step\-vans, utility trucks, funeral coaches, limousines, pickup truck bed enclosures, precision machining, and expandable foam plastic packaging. For more information, visit www.jbpoindexter.comfor more details.
  
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is the captive shared services unit of the J.B. Poindexter \& Co., Inc. The company, wholly owned by J. B. Poindexter \& Co., Inc.\& is headquartered in Houston, Texas, USA.
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
The US Recruiter – Salaried Roles will be responsible for managing the full\-cycle recruitment process for salaried positions across the organization’s US operations.
  
The role will partner closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition leadership to understand business requirements, develop effective recruitment strategies, identify and attract qualified candidates, and drive positions through the recruitment process to successful offer and hire.
  
The ideal candidate will have strong experience recruiting for US\-based salaried/professional positions and will be comfortable managing multiple requisitions in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. The recruiter will be expected to build strong candidate pipelines, including passive talent, while providing an excellent candidate and hiring\-manager experience.
  
Success in this role will require strong sourcing capability, stakeholder management, candidate assessment skills, organisation, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver against recruitment metrics such as time to fill, quality of hire, pipeline health, and overall hiring outcomes.
  
KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Full\-Cycle Recruitment
  
* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for US\-based salaried positions, from preparing job requisition and posting it, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, offer, and handoff to onboarding.
* Manage multiple open requisitions simultaneously while effectively prioritising roles based on business requirements and hiring timelines.
* Follow established Talent Acquisition processes and procedures to efficiently and effectively fill salaried positions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand position requirements, critical competencies, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
* Develop and execute recruiting plans and sourcing strategies based on the requirements of each position.
* Maintain ownership of assigned requisitions and proactively communicate progress, challenges, and potential risks.


Sourcing \& Talent Pipeline Development
  
* Utilize job boards, professional networks, internal databases, referrals, and other recruiting resources to identify qualified candidates.
* Develop strong pipelines of qualified candidates for current and future salaried hiring needs.
* Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through targeted sourcing and networking.
* Build and maintain professional networks to support ongoing US salaried recruitment.
* Research and identify new sourcing channels and approaches to improve candidate generation.
* Create and maintain compelling job postings aligned with the requirements of each position.


Candidate Screening \& Assessment
  
* Review resumes and applications and evaluate candidate qualifications against position requirements.
* Conduct initial phone/video screens to assess candidates' work history, education, experience, skills, career interests, compensation expectations, and overall fit.
* Assess candidates against defined competencies and job requirements and provide recommendations to hiring managers.
* Maintain a consistent and objective candidate assessment process.
* Ensure candidates receive timely communication and a positive recruitment experience throughout the hiring process.
* Coordinate and participate in video and/or onsite interviews as required.
* Provide guidance to hiring managers on candidate selection and recruitment best practices.


Hiring Manager \& Stakeholder Partnership
  
* Develop strong working relationships with hiring managers and business leaders supporting salaried recruitment.
* Conduct recruitment intake discussions and establish clear recruiting plans for assigned positions.
* Consult with hiring managers throughout the recruitment process and provide market and candidate insights.
* Educate new hiring managers on Talent Acquisition processes, workflows, interview practices, and expectations.
* Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition leadership to address recruitment challenges and hiring risks.
* Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding pipeline status, candidate activity, interview progress, and expected hiring timelines.


Offer \& Pre\-Employment Process
  
* Manage the candidate offer process in partnership with the hiring manager and appropriate HR stakeholders.
* Coordinate required background checks and other pre\-employment activities.
* Maintain timely communication with candidates throughout the offer and pre\-employment process.
* Support the transition of selected candidates into the onboarding process.


Reporting \& Recruitment Metrics
  
* Maintain accurate and timely recruitment activity within the Applicant Tracking System.
* Track and report recruitment metrics including open requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview activity, offers, time to fill, and hiring status.
* Provide transparent updates to Talent Acquisition leadership, hiring managers, and HR Business Partners.
* Proactively identify barriers that may impact hiring timelines and recommend solutions.
* Maintain accurate records related to recruitment activities and candidate status.


Talent Acquisition \& Process Improvement
  
* Participate in Talent Acquisition initiatives designed to improve recruiting effectiveness and candidate experience.
* Identify opportunities to improve sourcing strategies, recruiting processes, and candidate pipelines.
* Support workforce planning and recruitment initiatives as required.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for salaried recruitment.
* Complete special projects and other Talent Acquisition activities as assigned.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
* Bachelor's degree
* 5 to 7 years of experience in recruitment, sourcing, Talent Acquisition, or related experience.
* Experience recruiting for US\-based positions in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience managing full\-cycle recruitment processes.
* Strong experience sourcing and screening candidates for salaried/professional positions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with candidates, hiring managers, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a Talent Acquisition team.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
* Proven experience recruiting for US salaried/professional positions.
* Experience recruiting across multiple business functions.
* Strong passive candidate sourcing and talent\-pipeline development experience.
* Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting technologies.
* Experience with Ceridian Dayforce or other comparable ATS/HRIS systems.
* Experience with LinkedIn and other professional sourcing platforms.
* Experience partnering directly with US\-based hiring managers.
* Understanding of US recruitment practices and employment requirements.
* Experience working with recruitment metrics such as time to fill, pipeline conversion, and quality of hire.


**Code of Ethics:**  

JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited, requires the highest standard of ethics in all business dealings, with customers, suppliers, advisors, employees, and authorities. title: Full Lifecycle Recruiter I, WWAS TA
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This is a contractual role.  

  

Are you passionate about connecting talented people with meaningful careers? At Amazon, our recruiting team plays a critical role in shaping the future of the company by identifying and hiring exceptional talent across a wide range of roles. As a Full Lifecycle Recruiter I, you will manage the end\-to\-end recruiting process — from sourcing and engaging candidates to preparing them for interviews and closing offers. You will partner with hiring teams to understand their needs, build strong candidate pipelines, and deliver a positive experience for every person who interacts with Amazon during the hiring process.  

  

This is a role for someone who is curious, resourceful, and motivated by the challenge of finding the right person for the right opportunity. You will use data\-driven sourcing strategies, creative outreach methods, and your growing knowledge of Amazon's culture to attract qualified candidates efficiently. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy building relationships with both candidates and internal partners, we want to hear from you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Source and engage candidates using internal and external tools, Boolean search logic, and multiple sourcing channels to build high\-quality, unbiased candidate pipelines aligned with hiring team goals and service\-level expectations.
* Conduct thorough pre\-screens to assess candidate qualifications, compensation expectations, skill level, and availability, while clearly communicating the interview process and setting accurate expectations on leveling and compensation.
* Coach candidates on behavioral interviewing techniques and the overall interview process to ensure they are well\-prepared, creating a consistently positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Partner with hiring managers and recruiting team members to calibrate candidate profiles, share pipeline insights, and surface blockers or process improvement opportunities that strengthen hiring effectiveness.
* Leverage recruiting data and reporting mechanisms to track candidate funnel quality, measure sourcing project outcomes, and maintain data integrity across all recruiting systems and documentation.

  

A day in the life  

You will start your morning reviewing your candidate pipeline, following up with prospects, and scheduling pre\-screen calls. Throughout the day, you will connect with candidates to learn about their backgrounds, walk them through what to expect from Amazon's interview process, and help them put their best foot forward. You will also join intake meetings with hiring managers, collaborate with your recruiting team on sourcing strategies, and update candidate records to keep your data clean and actionable.  

  

About the team  

Our recruiting team is dedicated to delivering an outstanding hiring experience for candidates and internal partners alike. We work collaboratively to meet hiring goals while continuously improving our processes and tools. Whether you are refining a sourcing strategy or coaching a candidate through an offer, you will be part of a supportive team that values growth, creativity, and accountability. We are focused on building an inclusive hiring culture and are excited to welcome new team members who share that commitment.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree
* Experience building candidate sourcing and closing strategies
* 2\+ years of technical recruiting in high volume and high hiring bar environment experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with recruiting tools and systems, including resume databases, internet sourcing tools, and spreadsheets

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
Who We Are
  
**The name ThousandEyes was born from two big ideas:** the power to see things not ordinarily possible and the ability to collect insights from a multitude of vantage points. As the world continues its digital transformation and relies more on cloud services and the Internet, the"network" which is now both public and private, has become a black box our customers cannot see or understand.
  
  

Our Internet and cloud intelligence platform delivers the only collectively powered real\-time view of the Internet and private networks, cloud, and SaaS platforms, helping enterprises and service providers identify problems before they impact revenue, damage brand reputation, or halt employee productivity.
  
  

In August 2020, Cisco Systems completed the acquisition of ThousandEyes, which now forms the ThousandEyes Business Unit within the Cisco Networking Business Group and is the Network Assurance solution for Cisco across the Cisco Networking Cloud and Cisco Security Cloud. ThousandEyes is also a foundational component of Cisco’s growing Full\-Stack Observability "FS") business.
  
  

About The Role
  
We're all familiar with the technology, but have you ever wondered how the Internet actually works? At ThousandEyes, we spend every day working to help customers understand the gotchas of Internet\-based service delivery: how to identify problems, how to resolve, and how to avoid them in the future. Our Customer Engineering Support team who is now part of Cisco TAC is tasked with empowering our customers with ThousandEyes to ease their performance monitoring pains.
  
  

If you enjoy variety in job responsibilities, this is the job for you. A day may involve helping a customer identify network loss in an undersea cable, diagnose the cause of a route leak impacting significant portions of internet traffic, scripting an approach to monitoring a website's login flow, spinning up a lab environment to reproduce a strange set of behaviors seen in a customer's environment, saving a company hours of bridge time during a significant outage impacting their infrastructure by finding the smoking\-gun in a network outage, or simply helping someone understand the way that our applications work. This role will resolve customer technical challenges, collaborate directly with engineering to drive product quality, and leverage TAC AI capabilities, automation, and tools to deliver fast, scalable solutions. At senior levels, you will tackle complex, integrated cross\-product architectures and mentor peers across the team.
  
  

What You’ll Do
  
* Provide advanced technical expertise and leadership in solving complex, high\-impact customer issues
* Lead the creation, refinement, and delivery of technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge content
* Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to address systemic product issues and influence roadmap decisions
* Guide and mentor junior engineers, fostering technical growth and team development
* Submit and manage effective critical issues, coach others on how to engage with Engineering and Product teams
* Use advanced software skills to configure, troubleshoot, or automate ThousandEyes product workflow
* Drive serviceability, usability, and product improvement efforts through customer feedback and technical insights
* Represent the support function in cross\-functional meetings and customer engagements
* Contribute proactively to digital transformation by creating scripts, automation tools, and reusable assets
* Promote ThousandEyes' culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence
* Timely interaction with customers and internal teams requesting support via online\-chat, email and phone
* Active participation in 24x7 Support Coverage model
* Adopts and encourages adoption of AI and automation tools to improve resolution speed and accuracy, productivity, and quality
* Develops and disseminates intellectual capital (e.g., advanced diagnostics, automation workflows, and AI\-assisted troubleshooting guides) that supports global reuse across internal teams, Global Delivery Partners, and customers


Qualifications
  
* A standout"customer firs" attitude
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5\-8 \+ years of experience in a technical support, engineering, or related customer\-facing role
* Expert\-level certifications (e.g. CCIE) or equivalent advance technical credentials preferred
* Experience with Cloud/SaaS software products is highly desirable
* Familiar with core networking principles \- TCP/IP, DNS, web technologies, proxies and VoIP
* Experienced knowledge of virtualization technology \- containers, virtualBox, VMware, HyperV, Xen
* Experience in security \- authentication, permissions, SSO
* Knowledge of one computer languages and programming (Java, Python, XML, RESTAPI) frameworks are desirable
* Experience with the administration of Linux based Operations Systems a plus
* Experience in technical writing is a plus
* Ability to prioritize\& complete tasks in a timely fashion
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to technical and non\-technical users
* Proven troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Expert in one or more technical domains; broad knowledge across ThousandEyes and networking technologies
* Proficient in automation, programmability, orchestration, virtualization, and/or security
* Reads and applies industry standards, RFCs, and architectural documents
* Mentors team members and drives team goals into actionable initiatives
* Influences product development through trends analysis and cross\-functional collaboration
* Regional or global impact; regularly interacts with customers, leadership, and product teams
* Leads original and creative initiatives that are critical to organization success


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  

Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.
